doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Learning to dance from the Brown Skinned Models show
summary: Young says he learned time steps while the family band toured with a show he thinks was the Brown Skinned Models.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Where did you learn it? Where did you learn it?
I don‘t know…I don‘t know. I was a kid and I learned how to dance. I used to play on the, oh I know how I learned that, I used to play a family band went on the road with a show called the…

Oh, no, I can‘t think of the name of that my family went on, but they used to, what they did was, the Brown Skinned Models, I think it was the Brown Skinned Models was the name of this show. And our family band went on this show and they was dancing and everything and I learned how to dance from them, playing there, I learned how to do the time-step, break-over-the-top…all of those is steps I‘m mentioning now.
